input.prompt: [LENS] fixed 50mm, locked-off camera, no movement. [MOTION] over 4 seconds a thin thread of cyan light travels along the path of the ribbon, starting from the short thread at the bottom of the mark, going up the tall stem and coming back down into the loop, drawing the whole ribbon in one continuous stroke; as it passes, the ribbon lights up behind it with the violet-to-cyan gradient and stays lit; in the last second the complete mark holds perfectly still, exactly as in the last frame. [SUBJECT] a single lowercase b made of one continuous ribbon of light. [LIGHT] the ribbon is the only light source; the background stays solid very dark blue-black. [NEGATIVE] no camera motion, no zoom, no cut, no flicker, no text, no lens flare, no extra shapes, no particles, no sound.
input.negative_prompt: camera shake, zoom, cut, flicker, text, watermark, lens flare, extra objects, particles, color banding
